name: (🦑) Drill for Eggs
desc:
Drill for Eggs💥
⛏Dig down to find RARER and INSANE eggs!

👷How to play:
-Drill to increase POWER💥
-Dig down and bring Eggs to your Farm!🏡
-Avoid Animal Guards!👮‍♂️
-Hatch Eggs for RARE animals!🥚
-Make money, upgrade your drill, and build the biggest farm!🐶

Your Animals earn cash OFFLINE!💤

Like the game and join the group for EXCLUSIVE animal!👍
